error[ZBX-E0401]: a time is not a number of milliseconds
  while  reading --grace
  cause  'soon' is not a whole number of milliseconds from 0 to 86400000
  value  soon
  fix    give a time in milliseconds:   zbx stop web-1 --grace 5000
  more   zbx explain E0401
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0401.html
